title: Full System Integration, Ablation, and Championship Tournament
mission: Assemble the complete pre-2024 system, run all ablations and select one frozen core candidate under predeclared rules.
steps: Implement deterministic inference graph from snapshot to final P50.
Compare official raw, residual memory, individual MOS, static blend, dynamic router, router+specialists and distributional P50.
Run negative controls and shuffled-date tests.
Report full/slice/tail metrics and complexity cost.
Select the simplest candidate meeting promotion gates.
Freeze code/config/features/artifact hashes before opening confirmation.
acceptance: Exactly one frozen core candidate or explicit no-promotion result
failure: No candidate beats baselines robustly: freeze best baseline and return to research loop
